post.summary: Authenticate โ?? receive access + refresh tokens
post.description:
Authenticate with email + password.
Returns an access token (ONLY user_id + is_superadmin, Rule 15) and a refresh token.
Call POST /auth/select-context next to operate within a sede.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh pair (rotation).
Revoke the provided refresh token. Access tokens remain valid until expiry.

Create a new zone (tenant).

When `provision_database` is **true** (default), the API will:
1. Register the Zone in the global DB.
2. Generate the tenant database name automatically from the submitted slug.
3. Resolve the tenant database host automatically from the environment.
4. Run Alembic tenant migrations to HEAD.
5. Seed default categories / configuration.

On any failure the Zone record is rolled back and the partially-created
database is dropped (atomic from the caller's perspective).
